[SWS_CORE_00020] Semantics of an Error
⌈
An Error is the inability of
an assumed-bug-free API function to fulfill its specified purpose; it is often a conse-
quence of invalid and/or unexpected (i.e. possibly valid, but received in unexpected
circumstances) input data. An Error is recoverable.
⌋
